text:
nate: Afterdeploy snapshot: rolled v1.24.3 -> us-west-2. Deploy-bot shows all tasks green. Kicking off a quick sanity snapshot. If you're around, run the checklist below and paste results.

emily: Running basic health checks now. curl to /health returns 200 and uptime header looks fine.
```
$ curl -sS -I https://us-west-2.api.redwood.internal/health
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/json
x-service-uptime: 00:42:17
{"status":"ok"}
```

deploy-bot: synthetic-checker: embedding-route checks at 1755554350. Observed p95 jump to ~380ms in us-west-2a, and 3% transient 5xx on /v1/embeddings. No errors on generate route. Attaching quick sample ids: [id: emb-7642, emb-7643, emb-7647].

kevin: I'm seeing the same spike in live traces for embed requests. Errors are clustered to a small subset of pods on host pool 3. Suggest hold the remainder of canary rollout and pin routing back to v1.24.2 while we dig in.

sre-oncall: I can scale down canary traffic to 30% and pin routing to previous stable. Which do we prefer: immediate rollback or staged pin+monitor?

maya: vote: staged pin to 1.24.2 + reduce canary to 30%. That gives us a safer window to collect traces. I'll own follow-up runbook items. :thumbsup:

nate: Agreed. Kevin, please open the routing pin PR and apply the traffic reduction. Capture pod ids and a few request IDs for a deeper trace.

kevin: PR #7422 created: "routing: pin us-west-2 embed to v1.24.2 and reduce canary". Applying canary -> 30% now. Pod list with errors: redwood-embed-3a (pod-17b4), redwood-embed-3a (pod-17c0). Sample error log: 
```
[2025-03-21T15:59:12Z] ERROR inference-proxy: upstream returned 502 for request emb-7643 path=/v1/embeddings worker=17b4
```

sre-oncall: Deploybot scheduled a recheck in 10m at 1755554930 with synthetic suite limited to 30% traffic. I'll watch p95 and 5xx. If error rate continues above 1% we'll rollback fully.

deploy-bot: Note: recheck queued. Synthetic-run id synth-9001. Will post summary after run.

nate: Thanks all. Keep updates here and escalate to infra if host pool 3 memory looks abnormal. I'll prep a short release note blurb about the temporary pin and canary hold.
